# Verb Authority tuple-boundary regression rerun
# Target release: v0.10.0-beta.10
# Shell: Windows PowerShell

cd .\verb-authority-tuple-boundary-test_v10\

$env:VENV=".venv-beta10"
$env:VA_REF="v0.10.0-beta.10"
.\run.ps1

# Independently record the installed package version used by the rerun.

& .\.venv-beta10\Scripts\python.exe -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('verb-authority'))" |
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 results\installed-version.txt

Get-Content results\installed-version.txt

# Record the interpreter associated with that environment.

& .\.venv-beta10\Scripts\python.exe -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)" |
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 results\python-executable.txt

# Record SHA-256 hashes of the five frozen semantic inputs.

Get-FileHash tools.json, controls.json, policy.json, cases.json, EXPECTED.md -Algorithm SHA256 |
    Format-Table -AutoSize |
    Out-String |
    Set-Content -Encoding utf8 results\fixture-input-hashes.txt

Get-Content results\installed-version.txt
Get-Content results\python-executable.txt
Get-Content results\fixture-input-hashes.txt
